description: This Java source file contains a JUnit test class named OrderTest that tests the methods of the Order class, which is part of the OpenMRS project. It includes various unit tests for methods related to order activity, status, copying, and date logic, as well as setup and utility functions for testing.

classes.name: OrderTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the Order class methods in the OpenMRS healthcare system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup before each test, setting date format and creating a new Order instance.

methods.name: assertThatAllFieldsAreCopied
methods.description: Utility method to verify that all relevant fields are correctly copied by a specified method in the Order class.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueGivenOrderWithoutDates
methods.description: Tests that an order without date fields is not considered discontinued.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueBeforeActivationDate
methods.description: Tests that order is not discontinued before its activation date.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueGivenActivatedOrderWithoutEndDate
methods.description: Tests that an active order without an end date is not discontinued.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueActivatedOrderBeforeAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Tests that order is not discontinued before its auto-expire date.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueActivatedOrderAfterAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Tests that order is not discontinued after its auto-expire date.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueActivatedOrderBeforeDateStopped
methods.description: Tests that order is not discontinued before its date stopped.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldDiscontinueActivatedOrderAfterDateStopped
methods.description: Tests that order is considered discontinued after its date stopped.

methods.name: isActive_shouldBeCurrentAfterDateActivated
methods.description: Tests that an order is active after its activation date.

methods.name: isActive_shouldBeCurrentBetweenDateActivatedAndAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Tests that an order is active between activation and auto-expiry dates.

methods.name: isActive_shouldBeCurrentBetweenDateActivatedAndDateStopped
methods.description: Tests that an order is active between activation and stopped dates.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Verifies that cloning an order for discontinuation sets appropriate fields.

methods.name: copy_shouldCopyAllFields
methods.description: Tests that the copy method copies all relevant fields of Order.

methods.name: cloneForRevision_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Checks that cloning an order for revision copies fields appropriately with exclusions.

methods.name: isType_shouldTrueIfItIsTheSameOrIsASubtype
methods.description: Tests that isType returns true for the same or subtype orders.

methods.name: isType_shouldFalseIfItNeitherTheSameNorASubtype
methods.description: Tests that isType returns false if not same or subtype.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfOtherOrderIsNull
methods.description: Checks that method returns false when comparing with null.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptOfTheOrdersDoNotMatch
methods.description: Checks that method returns false if concepts differ.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfTheOrdersHaveTheSameConcept
methods.description: Verifies that method returns true if concepts match.

methods.name: getEffectiveStartDate_shouldReturnScheduledDateIfUrgencyIsScheduled
methods.description: Returns scheduled date when urgency is ON_SCHEDULED_DATE.

methods.name: getEffectiveStartDate_shouldReturnDateActivatedIfUrgencyIsNotScheduled
methods.description: Returns date activated when urgency is not ON_SCHEDULED_DATE.

methods.name: getEffectiveStopDate_shouldReturnDateStoppedIfDateStoppedIsNotNull
methods.description: Returns date stopped if it exists.

methods.name: getEffectiveStopDate_shouldReturnAutoExpireDateIfDateStoppedIsNull
methods.description: Returns auto-expire date if date stopped is null.

methods.name: isFuture_shouldReturnFalseForAVoidedOrder
methods.description: Checks that a voided order is not considered started.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldReturnFalseForAVoidedOrder
methods.description: Checks that a voided order is not considered discontinued.

methods.name: isExpired_shouldReturnFalseForAVoidedOrder
methods.description: Checks that a voided order is not considered expired.

methods.name: isActivated_shouldReturnTrueIfAnOrderWasActivatedOnTheCheckDate
methods.description: Confirms order activation status on a specific date.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnFalseForAVoidedOrder
methods.description: Tests that a voided order is not started.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnFalseIfDateActivatedIsNull
methods.description: Checks starting status if activation date is null.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnFalseIfTheOrderIsNotYetActivatedAsOfTheCheckDate
methods.description: Tests that order is not started if activation date is after check date.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnFalseIfTheOrderWasScheduledToStartAfterTheCheckDate
methods.description: Checks start status when scheduled date is after check date.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnTrueIfTheOrderWasScheduledToStartOnTheCheckDate
methods.description: Verifies that order started on scheduled start date.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnTrueIfTheOrderWasScheduledToStartBeforeTheCheckDate
methods.description: Verifies that order is considered started if scheduled start is before check date.

methods.name: isActive_shouldReturnTrueIfAnOrderExpiredOnTheCheckDate
methods.description: Checks if order is active on expiry date.

methods.name: isActive_shouldReturnFalseForADiscontinuedOrder
methods.description: Test that a discontinued order is not active.
